title: Hydroxytyrosol from Olive Oil Mitigates Endothelial Dysfunction in Diabetic Foot Ulcers via Redox, Inflammatory, and Survival Pathways.
authors: GokulRaj, Dhayalan Kalavathy; Jayasuriya, Ravichandran; Ramkumar, Kunka Mohanram
one_liner_zh: 该文研究橄榄油羟基酪醇对糖尿病足溃疡内皮功能障碍的保护作用，涉及分子对接但核心是药物机制与湿实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) remain a devastating complication of diabetes mellitus, with endothelial dysfunction playing a central role in their pathophysiology. Despite advances in wound care, current therapies often fail to address the complex molecular underpinnings of impaired healing. OBJECTIVES: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) remain a devastating complication of diabetes mellitus, with endothelial dysfunction playing a central role in their pathophysiology. Despite advances in wound care, current therapies often fail to address the complex molecular underpinnings of impaired healing. METHODS: Using network pharmacology, molecular docking, in-vitro experiments, we identified 170 potential targets of Hy in DFU treatment. RESULTS: We found nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells (NF-kappaB), serine/threonine protein kinase (AKT), and caspase-3 emerging as crucial hub proteins. Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinity (<-6.27 kcal/mol), particularly with Nrf2. In human endothelial cells exposed to a hyperglycemic microenvironment (HGM), Hy (5-10 muM) significantly restored cell viability while promoting Nrf2 nuclear translocation. This activation enhanced downstream antioxidant enzymes heme oxygenase-1, NAD(P)H quinone oxidoreductase 1, Catalase and suppressed oxidative stress markers p22phox, thioredoxin interacting protein. Hy inhibited NF-kappaB signaling and proinflammatory cytokines interleukin (IL)-6, IL-18 under hyperglycemic conditions. The compound also reversed HGM-induced suppression of angiogenic factors, vascular endothelial growth factor A, hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha, improving tube formation and migration in functional assays. Mechanistically, Hy restored AKT phosphorylation and modulated the Bcl-2 asscoiated X protein/B-cell lymphoma-2 (BAX/BCL2) ratio, protecting endothelial cells from apoptosis. CONCLUSION: Our findings highlight Hy's multifaceted action across redox, inflammatory, and survival pathways as a significant advantage over current single-target therapies. Although in vitro results are promising, animal models are needed to validate Hy's efficacy in the complex DFU microenvironment. Nevertheless, Hy's favorable absorption-distribution-metabolism-excretion profile and pleiotropic effects position it as an intriguing candidate for DFU management, potentially bridging preventive and regenerative approaches in diabetic wound healing.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病足溃疡（DFUs）仍是糖尿病的一种破坏性并发症，其中内皮功能障碍在其病理生理学中发挥核心作用。尽管伤口护理有所进展，当前疗法往往未能解决愈合受损所涉及的复杂分子基础。目的：糖尿病足溃疡（DFUs）仍是糖尿病的一种破坏性并发症，其中内皮功能障碍在其病理生理学中发挥核心作用。尽管伤口护理有所进展，当前疗法往往未能解决愈合受损所涉及的复杂分子基础。方法：通过网络药理学、分子对接和体外实验，我们鉴定了Hy在DFU治疗中的170个潜在靶点。结果：我们发现核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）、核因子κB（NF-kappaB）、丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶（AKT）和caspase-3是关键枢纽蛋白。分子对接显示强结合亲和力（<-6.27 kcal/mol），尤其是与Nrf2的结合。在暴露于高糖微环境（HGM）的人内皮细胞中，Hy（5-10 μM）显著恢复细胞活力，同时促进Nrf2核转位。这一激活增强了下游抗氧化酶血红素加氧酶-1、NAD(P)H醌氧化还原酶1、过氧化氢酶，并抑制了氧化应激标志物p22phox、硫氧还蛋白相互作用蛋白。在高糖条件下，Hy抑制了NF-kappaB信号通路及促炎细胞因子白细胞介素（IL）-6、IL-18。该化合物还逆转了HGM诱导的血管生成因子、血管内皮生长因子A、缺氧诱导因子1-α的抑制，改善了功能实验中的管形成和迁移。机制上，Hy恢复了AKT磷酸化，并调节了Bcl-2相关X蛋白/B细胞淋巴瘤-2（BAX/BCL2）比值，保护内皮细胞免受凋亡。结论：我们的发现强调了Hy在氧化还原、炎症和生存通路中的多层面作用，相较于当前单靶点疗法具有显著优势。尽管体外结果令人鼓舞，仍需动物模型来验证Hy在复杂DFU微环境中的疗效。然而，Hy良好的吸收-分布-代谢-排泄特性及多效性作用使其成为DFU管理的一个有前景的候选药物，可能弥合糖尿病伤口愈合中的预防性与再生性方法。
